name: TableCell

props.name: colSpan
props.description: The width of the expanded row's internal cell

props.name: hasAILabelHeader
props.description: Specify if the table cell is in an AI column

props.name: headers
props.description: The id of the matching th node in the table head. Addresses a11y concerns outlined here: https://www.ibm.com/able/guidelines/ci162/info_and_relationships.html and https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG20-TECHS/H43

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TableCell rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
